summary: [independently tuned (which model to ship)] the 16-feature model is worse on recall, precision, roc_auc (win/loss counts: recall 32/11/57, precision 59/16/25, roc_auc 71/26/3). [matched regularization (isolating the feature set alone)] no metric shows a significant difference. The 16-feature model is far more stable in which 3 features its SHAP explanation names as most important across resampled training data (82% vs 6% of splits matching the modal top-3 set) -- a real, measured benefit neither performance comparison above can see. Whether a recall/precision/AUC cost (arm_b) is worth an explanation-stability benefit is a judgment call this script can't settle, but arm_b is the comparison that should drive a 'which model to ship' decision -- arm_a is included because it isolates a different, also-useful question (does regularization alone explain the gap?).
